name: asset-center-personal-assets
description: Match, preview, and safely import a user's personal Asset Center models into Codex game projects — including story-driven semantic recall of the whole personal library.

interface.shortDescription: Bring your personal GLB models into Codex games.
interface.longDescription: Search and preview the GLB models published under your Asset Center account, choose the right model, and import a verified local copy into the current game workspace.
capabilities: Semantic recall of the personal asset library from a game story
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me my Asset Center models and help me import one into this game.
